brief: Demo project: footage and music are in media/demo (run `python3 examples/make_demo.py` once if it is empty). Vertical 9:16, accent colour #ffcc00, on-screen text in Russian.

tasks.prompt: Write 2 hook options and a 10-second script for a demo video that shows off beat-synced editing. Save it as out/crew_demo/SCRIPT.md.
Render a 3-second title card with `reel remotion TextReveal`: kicker «Reel Factory», title «МОНТАЖ ПОД БИТ», accent #ffcc00. Save out/crew_demo/card.mp4 and check it with reel watch.
Make a 10-second punchy cut of media/demo to media/demo/beat.wav with `reel auto --preview`, title «ДЕМО». Save out/crew_demo/edit.mp4 and check it with reel watch.
Review out/crew_demo/card.mp4 and out/crew_demo/edit.mp4. Write out/crew_demo/QA.md.
